Merge Per-Haplotype Annotations Into One Annotation Directory

Source: R/annotation-tools.R
merge_annotations.Rd

Phased (trio-binned or pangenome) assemblies come with one annotation per haplotype, for example the HPRC CAT files HG00438.1.chm13.gff3.gz and HG00438.2.chm13.gff3.gz. merge_annotations() converts each file (or reuses an existing annotation directory), tags every table with the haplotype label, makes identifiers unique by appending _<haplotype>, and writes one combined annotation directory. Transcript, gene and exon IDs therefore become <id>_<haplotype>, the convention expected for the row names of a haplotype-resolved IsoformicExperiment (rename the sequences of the per-haplotype transcript FASTA files the same way before building the Salmon index).

The source_gene_id / source_transcript_id columns (GRCh38 identifiers kept by Liftoff/CAT) are left untouched, which is what haplotype_summary() uses to compare haplotypes of the same gene.

Usage

merge_annotations(
  annot_paths,
  output_path = NULL,
  annot_name = "merged_haplotypes",
  id_suffix = TRUE,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

annot_paths

Named character vector: names are haplotype labels, values are GFF3/GTF files or annotation directories.

output_path

Directory under which the merged annotation directory is created. NULL uses get_isoformic_cache().

annot_name

Name of the merged annotation directory.

id_suffix

Logical. Append _<haplotype> to gene, transcript and exon identifiers (default TRUE). Set to FALSE when the identifiers are already unique across haplotypes.

overwrite

Logical. Replace an existing merged directory.

Value

The path to the merged annotation directory.

Examples

gff <- system.file("extdata", "example.gff3", package = "isoformic")
merged <- merge_annotations(
  c(hap1 = gff, hap2 = gff),
  output_path = tempdir(),
  annot_name = "example_diploid",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
#> ℹ Using cached annotation directory /tmp/RtmpmIi7db/example.
#> ℹ Using cached annotation directory /tmp/RtmpmIi7db/example.
tx <- read_parquet(file.path(merged, "annot_data_transcripts.parquet"))
table(tx$haplotype)
#> 
#> hap1 hap2 
#>   72   72 
head(tx$transcript_id)
#> [1] "ENST00000282397.9_hap1" "ENST00000615611.4_hap1" "ENST00000617835.4_hap1"
#> [4] "ENST00000543394.2_hap1" "ENST00000540678.2_hap1" "ENST00000541932.5_hap1"
